modoModAviso: Moderator mode — actions in this view can't be undone
sinPrecios: Nobody has added prices here yet. Do you know them?
otraBirraAria: Add another beer for this bar
eliminarBar: Delete this bar and its prices
eliminarBar1: The bar and all its prices are deleted. It can't be undone.
eliminarBar2: If the bar exists but was entered wrong, it's better to fix it than delete it: the prices are reports from people who were there.
reportar1: You're flagging that the price of {birra} is wrong. A moderator will review it.
reportar2: If it just changed, it's better to use {actualizar}: reporting is for prices that were never true.
reportado: Reported. Thanks, a moderator will review it.
foto1: The file is deleted from the bucket, not just from the list.
foto2: It's different from taking down a price or a review: photos are served from a public URL, so as long as the file exists anyone with the link can still see it. That's why it has to be deleted, and why this can't be undone.
precioEliminar1: The current report of {birra} at {precio} is taken down. It can't be undone.
precioEliminar2: Ratings and photos of this beer aren't touched: the beer stays on the list, without a price, until someone adds a new one.
viejo: This price is more than 45 days old. With inflation, take it as a rough reference.
